propositions: Continuous auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container during in-flight code reviews, causing the interrupted review to cast a fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote that blocks automatic reconciler recovery
Shutdown drain timeout (45s) expires before in-flight review completes (measured 260-911s), cancelling the worker and corrupting the review into a veto
Reconciler re-drives changes with NO LLM-Review vote, but the fail-closed -1 makes the change invisible to reconciler pre-filter, disabling the designed recovery

Retryable failure conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled, teardown-mid-review) should defer voting and remain vote-less so reconciler backfill re-drives them, while terminal conditions (indeterminate, finding) vote -1
Bounded escalation after N consecutive retryable failures on the same revision should cast fail-closed -1 with exhaustion note and emit VOTER_ERROR metric to surface the alarm
